chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Ali ibn Mahzayar. He said:

I wrote to Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon them): May I be your sacrifice! Shall I pray behind one who claims the doctrine of the body and one who takes the doctrine of Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman? So he (peace be upon him) wrote: Do not pray behind them, and do not give them from the zakat, and dissociate from them. Allah dissociates from them.

key_terms.لَا تُصَلُّوا خَلْفَهُمْ: Do not pray behind them: ruling forbidding congregational prayer behind those who hold anthropomorphist beliefs about God

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying behind anthropomorphists according to Imam al-Jawad in al-Amali?
ai.summary: Ali ibn Mahzayar wrote to Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (AS) asking whether he may pray behind those who hold anthropomorphist beliefs or follow the doctrine of Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman. The Imam instructs him not to pray behind them, not to give them zakat, and to dissociate from them, affirming that Allah Himself dissociates from those who hold such beliefs.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf from `Ali b. Mahzayar. He said:

I wrote to Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as): May I be your sacrifice! I pray behind one who claims the doctrine of the body and takes the doctrine of Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman. So, he (as) wrote: Do not pray behind them, and do not give them zakat. I dissociate from them, and Allah dissociates from them.
